replacement_units.content: Performance may rise while adaptive openness falls; present competence can improve inside a narrowing region of adaptive possibility.

Composite adaptive vector A=(P,R,E,O), where P=current performance, R=recovery, E=exploration/discovery, O=adaptive openness.

content.early: P_A approx P_B and O_A approx O_B

replacement_units.content: Adaptive closure is defined as P(t) increasing while O(t) decreases: current optimization improves while future adaptive openness declines.

No immediate failure is expected; after novelty O_A>O_B and R_A>R_B, with adaptive closure as the predicted phenomenon.
Equivalent recovery, exploration, and adaptive openness without Omega coupling under long horizons, repeated novelty, and adversarial perturbations would weaken RAD.
